en: Phew, I caught you! Good timing, too. I've been wanting to give you this!
Ta-da! It's Fly! Teach it to a Pokémon and it can carry you to any town you've visited, like a Pokémon Center you know.
Oh, and {player}, do you know about Hidden Grottoes?
Then let me tell you! Sometimes there's a little hollow among the trees where Pokémon like to hide. That's a Hidden Grotto!
You do? Great! Keep your eyes open, then. You might find one just around the corner!
Oops, I said I'd help the professor this afternoon! See you, {player}! Good luck in Driftveil!
